composer: Ask your local model…  Ctrl+Enter to send
chat_hint: Start a conversation, select a model, and keep your ideas local.
no_model: No model yet — import a GGUF in Models.
no_conversation: Create or select a conversation first.
delete_conversation: Delete this conversation and its history?
remove_model: Remove this catalog entry? The model file stays on disk.
model_hint: GGUF runs with llama.cpp. Ollama is optional. Import references files without copying them.
model_details: Select a model to see its details.
external_backend_settings: This service is external. Configure model roots and engines on its host.
download_hint: Downloads start only after confirmation. Completed GGUF files can be imported here.
settings_hint: Engine and directory changes restart only the backend owned by this app. Generation defaults apply to new messages. GPU support depends on your engine build.
diagnostics_hint: Live API diagnostics. Logs contain only event codes, never tokens, prompts or raw engine output.
connection_error: Cannot connect to backend. Open Diagnostics or restart the app.
unauthorized: Authentication failed. Supply OMNICORE_DESKTOP_TOKEN for an existing service; authentication stays enabled.
llama_unavailable: llama.cpp is unavailable. Set the llama-server executable in Settings.
backend_process_error: Backend process could not start. Check the installation.
backend_exited: Backend stopped unexpectedly. Restart the application.
backend_timeout: Backend did not become ready in time.
model_required: Select a model before sending a message.
path_not_allowed: Directory is not allowed. Add it in Settings on the backend host.
out_of_memory: The model exceeds available memory. Use a smaller model or context.
gpu_unavailable: No working GPU engine/device was found. Use Auto for CPU fallback or check engine diagnostics.
busy: Finish or stop the current generation first.
no_answer: There is no answer to copy yet.
already_running: OmniCore is already using this data directory.
config_error: Cannot read desktop settings. Check desktop.json in your configuration directory.
stream_disconnected: The response stream disconnected. Partial text is kept in history.
ollama_managed: Ollama loads the model on the first message.
invalid_settings: Invalid settings. Check parameters and directory permissions.
invalid_backend_url: Invalid backend URL. Use local HTTP or remote HTTPS.
incompatible_backend: The backend is not compatible with the OmniCore API.
welcome_steps:
1. Import a local GGUF or download one in Models.
2. Configure llama.cpp in Settings when needed. Ollama is optional.
3. Load a compatible model, create a conversation and send a message. Model weights are never bundled.
report_saved: Diagnostic report saved without tokens, paths or conversation content.
report_failed: Cannot save the diagnostic report. Choose a writable location.
unknown_error: Unexpected backend error. Reconnect or check diagnostics.
empty_response: The engine returned no final answer. Check the chat template and finish reason; the context was not increased automatically.
reasoning_limit_reached: The token limit was used for reasoning before a final answer. Disable thinking if the model supports it, or explicitly adjust the answer limit.
context_limit_exceeded: The prompt exceeds the model context. Shorten the conversation or explicitly choose a context supported by the model and available memory.
engine_invalid_response: The inference engine returned an invalid response.
cuda_hint: Keep the CPU engine configured. For GPU set device=auto and GPU layers > 0. Missing GPU/runtime falls back to CPU in auto mode; explicit CUDA0 requires a detected device. Out-of-memory remains an error. CUDA hardware validation is required.
cpu_available: CPU ready. Auto will use CPU if no GPU engine is found.
gpu_offload_unverified: The engine did not confirm moving any layers to GPU. Auto can use CPU; check GPU settings and engine compatibility.
cuda_runtime_unavailable: The CUDA engine cannot load its runtime libraries or driver. Check diagnostics or use Auto/CPU.
gpu_layers_required: Select at least one GPU layer to require CUDA.
backend_in_use: A server already uses this data directory. Connect to that server; a second backend was not started.
backend_auth_required: An existing server requires authentication. Configure OMNICORE_DESKTOP_TOKEN using the connection guide.
backend_lock_error: Cannot access the backend process lock. Check data directory permissions.
backend_port_error: Cannot allocate a local server port. Check networking and try again.
backend_start_failed: The backend could not start. Check the port and Python dependencies, or use the complete AppImage.
server_ownership: Only a server started by this app can be stopped or reconfigured here. An existing server is attached without taking ownership.
server_lan: Allow phone access on the local network
lan_security_hint: Use only a trusted private network: local HTTP does not encrypt traffic. Authentication remains required. Do not forward this port to the Internet. If the phone cannot connect, check that both devices use the same network and allow this port in your firewall. Changing LAN settings restarts your backend.
revoke_confirm: This device will need to pair again. Revoke its access?
stop_server_confirm: Stop the server? Active generation will be cancelled and connected devices will disconnect.
pairing_hint: Scan this QR code in Android settings. It grants access to this backend and its shared conversation history. The one-time pairing code expires in two minutes; the main API token is never shown.
lan_no_address: No private IPv4 network is available. Connect this computer to your trusted LAN and retry.
backend_token_error: Cannot read the private server credential. Check its ownership and permissions.
backend_token_or_port_error: Cannot prepare the server credential or listening port. Check private data permissions and port availability.
delete_all_confirm: Permanently delete all {count} conversations and their messages? This cannot be undone. Active generation will be cancelled. Models, downloads and configuration will remain.
history_changed: History changed on another device. Refresh and confirm deletion again.
pairing_invalid: The pairing code is invalid, expired, cancelled or already used. Create a new code.
pairing_admin_required: Manage pairing from the computer that owns the server.
pairing_lan_required: Enable the private LAN server before pairing.
pairing_rate_limited: Too many pairing attempts. Wait one minute.
forbidden_network: This server accepts private LAN connections only.
token_security_hint: Additional tokens grant access to this backend and its shared history. Keep them private. The full value is shown only at creation; the clipboard is cleared after 45 seconds.
token_once: Copy this token now and enter it in the Android API token field or your external client. It cannot be displayed again.
revoke_all_confirm: Disconnect all paired devices and revoke all additional API tokens? The main server credential is preserved.
pairing_complete: Pairing code accepted. The phone is finishing the connection.
pairing_network_error: Connection interrupted. Retrying status; you can generate a new code.
pairing_expired: Pairing code expired. Generate a new QR on the computer and scan it.
pairing_used: This code is already bound to another pairing attempt. Use Retry on the original phone or generate a new QR.
lan_restart_required: The network address changed after server startup. Restart your server before generating a new QR.
token_expiry_invalid: Choose an expiry within the next 366 days, or no expiry.
providers_security_hint: The Linux backend makes external requests and stores keys in the system Secret Service/KWallet. Keys are never saved in chat or JSON. Configure the key on the computer, or transfer it once over HTTPS. Select a paid/cloud model explicitly; automatic titles also use that provider. No automatic local-to-cloud fallback.
provider_sampling: Send sampling parameters supported by the selected model
provider_delete_confirm: Remove this provider, its stored key and catalog entries? Conversation history is preserved.
provider_key_saved: Key stored on the backend; its value is not displayed.
provider_key_missing: No provider key is stored. Configure it on the backend computer.
provider_test_ok: Authenticated model-list request succeeded. Generation was not invoked.
provider_cost_confirm: Add this external model to the chat selector? Selecting it sends conversation history to the provider and may incur charges on your key. Automatic titles make a small additional request to the same provider.
paid_model: External API · usage may be paid
provider_secret_store_unavailable: System Secret Service is unavailable or locked. Unlock the session keyring on the Linux backend. No plaintext fallback is used.
provider_not_found: Provider configuration no longer exists. Refresh the list.
provider_endpoint_invalid: Use the official endpoint, or a public HTTPS custom endpoint without credentials or query parameters.
provider_key_reentry_required: Changing the destination requires a new key. An existing key is never forwarded to a changed endpoint.
provider_key_invalid: Enter a valid printable API key without whitespace.
provider_auth_failed: The provider rejected this key or its permissions. Check the saved key on the backend.
provider_rate_limited: The provider rate or quota limit was reached. Wait or check the account limits.
provider_model_not_found: The provider does not expose this model or endpoint to your account.
provider_unavailable: The provider is unavailable. Retry later; no fallback provider was called.
provider_request_rejected: The provider rejected the request. Check model capabilities and configured parameters.
provider_parameter_unsupported: The selected model/provider does not support these sampling parameters. Disable sampling or adjust its range.
provider_response_invalid: The provider returned an invalid or oversized response.
provider_content_blocked: The provider stopped this request or requested an unsupported tool.
provider_connection_failed: Cannot connect to the provider. Check network access and TLS.
provider_permission_required: This API token cannot manage providers. Ask the computer owner for a token with provider permission.
provider_key_requires_https: Configure the key on the Linux computer, or use HTTPS to transfer it. Provider keys cannot be sent over LAN HTTP.
provider_confirmation_required: Explicitly confirm adding an external model before using it.
provider_requires_server_auth: External providers require an authenticated backend. Start the backend from the desktop app or configure its API token.
